div.div:
Retention
VictoriaMetrics, VictoriaLogs, VictoriaTraces and Pyroscope keep 7 days. ClickHouse keeps the same traces and logs for 90 days (7 days on the hot volume, then the RustFS cold volume), which is where a question older than a week goes. Edge access logs reach ClickHouse only: the VictoriaLogs pipeline drops them. Vector writes each pod line twice on purpose — straight to VictoriaLogs and, through its own otlp/vector receiver, to ClickHouse — so the shared OTLP receiver never routes those lines into VictoriaLogs a second time. Every arrow into Grafana is a query, one datasource per backend.
